validation_scope: Offline identity and recorded-fact consistency; no new experiment, independent replication or scholarly judgment.

holdout.conditions: 4 convenience repositories, 8 release-centred revisions, 24 fixed anchors each, 5 measured trajectories, 3 fresh memory processes/modality/method/repository; single Apple M1 Pro.

tasks.conditions: 9 adapted upstream assertion cases,3 development repositories,72 isolated children; same unique physical-line budget; no LLM or human gold labels.

claims.statement_en: Pinned source text and artifact identity are auditable
claims.statement_zh: 固定源码与产物身份可核查
claims.boundary_en: Exact source, test, license and measured implementation hashes resolve to retained pins. This is identity, not provenance authenticity, authorship or semantic truth.

claims.statement_en: Incremental replay matches uncached bounded resolver on frozen holdout
claims.statement_zh: 固定留出样本中的有界解析器回放一致
claims.boundary_en: All 768 references, every emitted timing and memory digest, complete grid and every frontier count match; zero mismatches. Independent natural-code semantic correctness and useful coverage remain unestablished; authored semantic regression tests are separate evidence.

claims.statement_en: Selective replay reduces measured cost versus persistent indexing plus whole-corpus reuse
claims.statement_zh: 强基线下固定样本回放耗时下降
claims.boundary_en: Frozen target >=20% replay reduction in >=3/4 repositories, RSS <=2x baseline and <=512MiB, correctness gate and full negative records. Observed 4/4. Do not relabel replay reduction cold-start speedup or agent speedup.

claims.statement_en: Natural-code semantic freshness can be certified with useful coverage
claims.statement_zh: 有用的自然代码语义fresh证书
claims.boundary_en: Cannot pass on replay equality. Need externally grounded behavioral/semantic change labels and a predeclared nonzero risk/coverage objective; current complete reference count is 0/768. Zero false acceptances at zero acceptances is not evidence of useful certification.

claims.statement_en: Graph context covers more executed source on the nine adapted assertion cases in macro average
claims.statement_zh: 九个开发样本中的执行见证覆盖
claims.boundary_en: Nine eligible cases, 72 children, trace/untraced parity, exact witness unions and means. Graph 0.5392489488 vs BM25 0.3744928034. Preserve Pluggy reversal and broad-span cases. Never label execution_density gold precision.

claims.statement_en: Graph evidence improves task success or task-relevant context over simpler fresh retrieval
claims.statement_zh: 独立任务上下文质量及智能体收益
claims.boundary_en: Historical graph/freshanchor/BM25 tie 24/25; current witness is not end-to-end evidence. Need untouched tasks, same query/localization/budget, independent labels for retrieval and actual downstream test-outcomes for agent benefit; external gold retrieval alone cannot set agent benefit to supported.

claims.statement_en: Distinct research contribution beyond established incremental dependency tracking
claims.statement_zh: 超出已有增量依赖原理的研究新颖性
claims.boundary_en: Prior-work comparison must identify a nontrivial new empirical finding or method boundary. Hash tracing/negative dependencies are established. Mechanical validator can check citations/pins, not adjudicate novelty.

claims.statement_en: Independent external reproduction or independent human scholarly evaluation occurred
claims.statement_zh: 独立外部复现与人工学术评议
claims.boundary_en: Requires identifiable actual external run/reviewer record and scoped outcome. CI, same-machine rerun, model-based review and this audit do not satisfy it. Journal/conference acceptance is separate and never inferable from a research-quality gate.

unmet_criteria.en: Independent semantic labels and nonzero useful acceptance coverage; current 0/768 complete graphs.
unmet_criteria.zh: 独立语义标签和非零有效接受覆盖；当前完整图0/768。

unmet_criteria.en: Untouched task-context labels with fixed budgets and strong lexical/context-expansion controls. Execution witnesses are not relevance gold.
unmet_criteria.zh: 未使用任务的独立上下文标签、固定预算和强词法/普通展开对照。执行见证不是相关性gold。

unmet_criteria.en: Actual downstream task outcomes if agent improvement remains a claim. Historical graph and simpler fresh baselines tie 24/25.
unmet_criteria.zh: 若声称智能体收益，需要真实下游任务结果；历史图与简单fresh基线均24/25。

unmet_criteria.en: Broader or prospective workloads and independent environment replication; repeated trajectories are not independent datasets.
unmet_criteria.zh: 更广泛或前瞻工作负载及独立环境复现；重复轨迹不是独立数据集。

unmet_criteria.en: A defensible contribution relative to prior work, with independent scrutiny. Publication or academic firstness is not itself required, and this checker cannot judge novelty.
unmet_criteria.zh: 相对已有工作的可辩护贡献及独立检视；不把发表或学术首创本身作为必要条件，检查器不能判定新颖性。
